Start spawns the agent a host's template describes, on that host, with
what the template says and nothing else: the agent is named after the
template, and is a helper of whoever started it. A template whose agent is
already there (running, or ended and not cleaned up) isn't started again:
template resume brings back an ended one. --host starts it on another
host.

Usage:
  agent template start <template> [flags]

Examples:
  agent template start builder
  agent template start builder --host hub

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for start
      --host string   Host whose template it is (default: this host)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
